"""Recover declared historical inputs; validate the whole plan before any recovered file write."""
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

CHECKPOINT = 'docs/checkpoints/SPEC-LANGUAGE-SELF-CONTAINMENT.1.3.3.0.2.1.4.0-recovery.json'
ROOTS = tuple(PurePosixPath('.linkedspec-data/scratch/' + name) for name in (
    'selfcontain13302', 'selfcontain1330201', 'selfcontain1330210', 'selfcontain13302140'))
GIT_INPUTS = {'perl/LinkedSpec/ActionIR/MethodLowering.pm',
              't/codeblock_push_composition_perl.t'}

def prepare(record, repository, destination):
    repository = repository.resolve()
    destination = destination.resolve()
    owned = (repository / '.linkedspec-data/scratch/selfcontain13302140').resolve()
    assert owned.is_relative_to(repository) and destination.is_relative_to(owned), 'undeclared recovery destination'
    def check_volume(path):
        while not path.exists():
            path = path.parent
        assert path.stat().st_dev == repository.stat().st_dev, 'wrong volume'
    check_volume(destination)
    plan, paths = [], set()
    for row in record['recoverable_inputs']:
        name = PurePosixPath(row['path'])
        assert not name.is_absolute() and '..' not in name.parts, 'unsafe stored path'
        assert any(name.is_relative_to(root) for root in ROOTS), 'undeclared scratch root'
        assert str(name) not in paths, 'duplicate recovery path'
        paths.add(str(name))
        target = (destination / str(name)).resolve()
        assert target.is_relative_to(destination), 'escaping recovery target'
        check_volume(target)
        if row['storage'] == 'source_lines':
            assert all(isinstance(line, str) for line in row['source_lines'])
            data = ''.join(row['source_lines']).encode('utf-8')
        else:
            assert row['storage'] == 'git_blob'
            assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}', row['commit']), 'invalid capture commit'
            assert row['git_path'] in GIT_INPUTS, 'undeclared Git input'
            data = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', row['commit'] + ':' + row['git_path']], cwd=repository)
        assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest() == row['sha256'], 'source identity mismatch'
        plan.append((target, data))
    return plan

def restore(record, repository, destination):
    plan = prepare(record, repository, destination)
    for target, data in plan:
        target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        assert target.parent.stat().st_dev == repository.stat().st_dev, 'wrong parent volume'
        target.write_bytes(data)
    return len(plan)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    root = Path.cwd().resolve()
    record = json.loads((root / CHECKPOINT).read_text())
    # This mirror demonstrates source recovery without overwriting retained evidence.
    target = root / '.linkedspec-data/scratch/selfcontain13302140/recovered'
    print('recovered', restore(record, root, target), 'declared inputs under', target.relative_to(root))
